The '''1939–40 [[La Liga]]''' was the ninth season since its establishment and the first one after the [[Spanish Civil War]], which forced the suspension of the competition for three years. The season started on 3 December 1939, and finished on 28 April 1940.

[[Atlético Aviación]] won its first title ever.

==Format changes==
For this season, the team qualified in the 10th position would face the second qualified team from [[1939–40 Segunda División|Segunda División]] in a single-game play-off at a neutral venue. The winner would play the next season of La Liga.

Due to the several damages in [[Estadio Carlos Tartiere (1932)|Estadio Buenavista]] after the Spanish Civil War, [[Real Oviedo|Oviedo]] did not play this season. However, the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation|Spanish Football Federation]] assured them a berth in the [[1940–41 La Liga]].

[[Atlético Madrid|Athletic Madrid]] changed its name to ''Athletic Aviación'', after its merge with Aviación Nacional. Despite being relegated to Segunda División, it remained in the league by winning a play-off match against [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] for occupying the vacant berth after the resignation of Oviedo. Due to the damages at [[Estadio Metropolitano de Madrid]], they played their games during this season at [[Estadio Chamartín]], and one game at [[Campo de Fútbol de Vallecas|Vallecas]].

[[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta]] and [[Real Zaragoza|Zaragoza]] made their debut in La Liga.
